status: frozen while V19W response production was running, after 51 of 5082 checkpoints existed with zero failures, but before V19W completed, before combining any V19W spectrum, fitting either integrated abundance or a regional temperature, opening replacement-cluster lensing data, or changing gravity physics
purpose: Commission the exact V19H integrated and regional spectrum-combination and temperature-fit chain on both clusters before launching all 494 regional fits.

registered_workload.commissioning_region_selection_rule: within each cluster, the unique accepted region with the greatest sum of frozen V19U source_band_events; no spectrum, response shape, temperature, fit statistic, front, lensing coordinate or published temperature enters selection

combination.integrated_aperture: the union of every accepted V19M region, represented by all V19W cells for that cluster without overlap or exclusion
combination.regional_aperture: the exact selected V19M region represented by every V19W cell for that cluster and bin_id
combination.primary_combination: directly combine the complete deterministic source-PHA list for the aperture; do not use fitted temperature or response shape to select or weight cells
combination.failure_rule: retain the failed command and products; do not drop cells, change grouping, alter background scaling, or introduce an observation hierarchy after seeing a spectral or fit outcome

order: combine and group the full integrated spectrum for both clusters
fit each integrated spectrum with abundance free
freeze each cluster's integrated best-fit abundance
combine and group the preregistered commissioning region for both clusters
fit each commissioning region with its own cluster's integrated abundance fixed
fit_sequence.regional_abundance_rule: fixed to the same cluster's integrated best-fit value

normalization.initial_rule: max(1e-8, 0.01 times the background-unsubtracted 0.5-7.0 count rate in counts per second)

fit_sequence.optimization: levmar; if it fails or returns a non-finite statistic, run neldermead and then one levmar polish
fit_sequence.uncertainty: Sherpa conf 68-percent profile-likelihood interval for temperature with every other free parameter profiled

gates.failure_rule: do not start the 494-region production fit; report the failed cluster and stage without changing grouping, energy band, nH, redshift, abundance rule, statistic, optimizer sequence, parameter bounds or cell membership

advance.if_all_gates_pass: freeze and run all 494 regional combinations and fits with the identical rules
advance.if_any_gate_fails: issue an implementation or identifiability report before any new protocol; do not inspect replacement-cluster lensing targets
